protocol.auc: macro one-vs-rest ROC AUC from softmax probabilities
protocol.augmentation: RandomCrop(32,pad=4), RandomHorizontalFlip, AutoAugment(CIFAR10 policy), ToTensor, Normalize(CIFAR100 stats)
protocol.class_metrics: macro-averaged one-vs-rest precision, recall, and F1
protocol.flops_method: analytical estimate for Conv2d, Linear, attention matrix operations, cosine classifier and approximate FFT; see docs/benchmarking.md for operations omitted
protocol.inference_timing: single-image latency is measured at batch size 1; inference FPS is model-only throughput at the configured batch size; pipeline throughput includes data loading
protocol.model_size: serialized pytorch_model.bin checkpoint in decimal MB
protocol.test_set_history: The official CIFAR-100 test images are excluded from training, but prior pilot and pipeline evaluations inspected test results; this is not a blinded holdout.
protocol.train_validation: stratified 45,000/5,000 split from official 50,000 training images
